non_recommendation_reasons: Prior frozen evidence demonstrates zero final outcome improvements.
Seventeen of twenty-five outputs were false or not applicable.
Only three of twenty-five outputs were unique factually valid findings.
Customer recommendation before empirical comparative results would be premature.
required_corrections_adopted_into_design: Demonstrate outcome improvement greater than zero before a positive value claim.
Freeze objective baselines and denominator rules.
Prevent post-hoc interpretation of useful intelligence and evolution fitness.
Keep model, session and independent lineage counts separate.
Use matched low-risk tasks and preserve negative results.
falsification_risks: Abstract metrics can be gamed through post-hoc weighting.
Session counts can be misrepresented as independent diversity.
Tasks can be overfit to TITMAS telemetry rather than external value.
known_limitations: Model review is not Human Decision or experimental evidence.
Sanitized review preserves conclusions and omits credentials and hidden reasoning.
